hist_case.problem: Build V3 Perception: face/body/biometric evidence fusion under explicit consent, layered on V2 Evidence Fusion
hist_case.case_text: Third of five Communication System versions (founder-locked build order 2026-08-06/07/08). Prototype already proven 27/27 in scripts/prototype-perception-v3.mjs; ports into a real service depending on V2 (services/evidence-fusion-service.js).
